newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining cut to hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers Inc said Thursday it downgraded its rating on Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co to hold from buy based on valuation.

-- "While we continue to believe that the fundamentals at 3M are the strongest in many years, our reduced rating reflects two primary factors," said analyst Jonathan Rosenzweig in a report. He cited a recent runup in the share price and said foreign exchange likely will limit any upside to Salomon's earnings estimates on 3M this year.
-- "In our opinion, the risk/reward pendulum clearly has shifted against the stock, leading us to be more neutral in the near term," the analyst said.
-- Salomon projects 3M will post earnings of $4.15 in 1997 and $4.70 in 1998.

-- Sales likely will be hurt by two to three percent this year by foreign exchange, Rosenzweig noted. He projects the company's operating margins will expand to 18.5 percent in 1997 from 17.5 percent in 1996 and reach 19 percent in 1998, driven by productivity improvements and easier raw material cost comparisons.
